milestone: B2Z-2H (proposed successor to B2Z-P1.7, NOT B2Z-P1/P2)
status: NON_EXECUTABLE_CONTRACT_DESIGN_ONLY -- no code implementing live acquisition is built or activated in this artifact
purpose: Define the upstream_source -> direct_funder -> creator qualification contract as a genuinely separate stage from direct B2Z (funder -> creator), per P1.7's explicit finding that B2Z's own canonical contract covers direct funding only.
architecture: LOCAL-FIRST -> CACHE-FIRST -> SELECTIVE RPC, mirroring three_sw2's proven historical acquisition pattern (16 RPC calls for 13 launches, not 39) rather than B2Z's own current all-or-nothing-per-member design

inputs.required: QUALIFIED B2Z direct-funding output ONLY -- creator, direct_funder, direct_funding_signature, direct_funding_amount, direct_funding_time, all RAW_ONCHAIN_EVIDENCE tier (i.e. this contract must not be fed local-only P1.6/P1.7-tier predictions as if they were qualified inputs; it consumes B2Z's LIVE, RAW-VERIFIED results once B2Z-P2/live-B2Z produces them)
inputs.explicit_non_input: B2Z-2H does NOT independently re-derive direct funding -- it strictly composes on top of already-qualified direct-hop evidence, avoiding duplicate acquisition

stage_local.name: LOCAL_UPSTREAM_CANDIDATE_DISCOVERY
stage_local.method: relational search of transfer_index (or the pre-built, volume-gated funder_upstream_links where available) for rows WHERE destination=direct_funder AND block_time<direct_funding_time AND amount_lamports>0, most recent first -- exactly the method P1.7 used manually
stage_local.output: zero or more candidate (upstream_source, upstream_signature, upstream_amount, upstream_block_time) tuples per direct-funder

stage_cache.name: CACHE_FIRST_RAW_LOOKUP
stage_cache.method: before any live dispatch, check database/transaction_first_lineage.db's tf_transaction_cache (keyed by signature) for the candidate upstream signature -- if present and rpc_verified=1, treat as already-raw-verified with ZERO new RPC cost, exactly mirroring three_sw2's materialize_three_sw2_shadow_corpus.py cache-first design
stage_cache.explicit_caveat: this cache does NOT currently overlap the B2N/B2Z 20-member cohort's specific signatures (confirmed 0 matches in P1.8) -- cache-first only helps when the SPECIFIC candidate signature happens to already be cached, which is not guaranteed for any given member

stage_selective_rpc.name: TARGETED_RAW_VERIFICATION
stage_selective_rpc.method: getTransaction(candidate_upstream_signature) -- a SINGLE targeted call per candidate that survived stage_local and stage_cache without resolution, using the qualified B2Z-P1 durable/resumable execution boundary (NOT a new unsafe batch path) as the executor
stage_selective_rpc.rpc_cost: 1 per unresolved candidate (never 2, since the candidate signature is already known from stage_local -- no equivalent of B2Z's CREATOR_HISTORY discovery stage is needed at the upstream hop, because the direct funder's own inbound history search already IS the candidate-discovery step)

self_loop.definition: upstream_source == the creator OR upstream_source == the direct_funder itself
self_loop.action: REJECT the candidate before any RPC dispatch -- P1.7 proved this is a real, measured failure mode (3/9 raw candidates in the 20-member cohort), not hypothetical

dust.definition: upstream_amount_lamports below the existing MIN_UPSTREAM_SOL threshold (0.01 SOL, src/core/second_hop_builder.py)
dust.action: FLAG as low-confidence; do not auto-reject (a genuinely small legitimate funding amount is possible), but do not treat a dust-level match as sufficient LOCAL_EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENT_FOR_DISCOVERY tier without additional corroboration -- route to RAW_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED per the B2Z-P3 policy
dust.measured_evidence: 3 of 5 genuine (non-self-loop) upstream candidates in the 20-member cohort were exactly 1 lamport -- overwhelmingly likely dust/probe transactions, not real funding

post_direct_funding_upstream_transfer.definition: a candidate transfer_index row whose block_time is AFTER (not before) the direct_funding_time it is supposed to precede
post_direct_funding_upstream_transfer.action: STRUCTURALLY IMPOSSIBLE as upstream funding -- REJECT unconditionally, never a candidate, regardless of amount or any other signal (an upstream source must fund the direct funder BEFORE the direct funder funds the creator, by definition of the 2-hop chain)

impossible_temporal_ordering.definition: upstream_block_time >= direct_funding_time (subsumes post_direct_funding_upstream_transfer but stated generally for same-instant edge cases)
impossible_temporal_ordering.action: REJECT -- the local_stage's own SQL query (block_time < direct_funding_time) already structurally prevents this from ever being selected as a candidate in the first place, so this is a defense-in-depth check, not expected to ever trigger given correct query construction

service_mega_hub_ambiguity.definition: upstream_source exceeds the existing MAX_UPSTREAM_FUNDERS=50 threshold when checked against funder_upstream_links, OR carries a known bot/service creator_tags entry
service_mega_hub_ambiguity.action: does NOT reject the candidate, but attaches SERVICE_DISTRIBUTION_REVIEW_REQUIRED metadata -- mirrors B2Z-P1's FAN_OUT_REVIEW_ORDINALS non-gating design exactly. Measured real example: AxiomRXZAq1Jgjj9pHmNqVP7Lhu67wLXZJZbaK87TTSk reaches 131 distinct funders (2.6x the exclusion threshold).

conflicting_upstream_candidates.definition: more than one transfer_index row satisfies the temporal/amount filter for the same direct_funder
conflicting_upstream_candidates.action: select the single MOST RECENT qualifying candidate (mirrors B2Z's own existing candidates[0] rule exactly, for architectural consistency) -- but if the second-most-recent candidate is close in time/amount to the selected one, attach an AMBIGUOUS_MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES review flag rather than silently discarding the alternative
conflicting_upstream_candidates.no_extra_rpc_for_disambiguation: consistent with B2Z's existing contract -- no additional provider calls are spent trying to distinguish between multiple local candidates; ambiguity is flagged for review, not resolved by spending more budget

outputs: creator (from qualified direct B2Z input, not re-derived)
temporal_ordering_proof (upstream_time < direct_time < migration_time, explicitly re-verified from raw block_times, never assumed)
evidence_classification (per B2Z-P3's five-category policy, applied at the upstream hop)
cache_hit (bool -- whether stage_cache resolved this without a live RPC call)

shared_source_candidate_metadata (whether this upstream_source also appears for other members' direct funders in the same cohort/batch -- CANDIDATE_SHARED_FUNDING_EVIDENCE only, never SAME_OPERATION, per P1.7's explicit precedent)
explicit_prohibitions_preserved_from_b2z: candidate-only output, no canonical operation attribution
no new authority states beyond what B2Z-P1 already established
reuses the SAME durable/resumable executor -- does not weaken or duplicate B2Z-P1's pre-dispatch durability, resume, or budget-accounting guarantees
relationship_to_existing_second_hop_syst: B2Z-2H is a RAW-VERIFICATION UPGRADE layer that sits ON TOP of the existing local-only SecondHopExpansionBuilder (funder_upstream_links/creator_second_hop), not a replacement for it. Local-only second-hop discovery continues to run unchanged for the vast majority of relationships (Level A, EP4.0/4.1-compatible); B2Z-2H is invoked only for the selective subset warranting Level-B verification per the B2Z-P3 policy.
no_code_written_for_this_contract: correct for a design-only artifact -- B2Z-P1's existing durable executor is EXPLICITLY intended to be reused (not reimplemented) when this contract is eventually authorized for implementation
